text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while getting ready for the Hopeful Stakes, Curren Chan bursts into my office with a complaint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega has been overworking herself by doing excessive training on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to get her to take it easy, so I decide on bringing her to the planetarium with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back, she opens up a bit about her feelings and her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the burden she's been carrying has become slightly lighter. From this point forward, she refrains from burning herself out.
